valid.condition: {{!body.error && body.id === parameters.task_id && (!body.response || length(keys(body.response)) === 0 || body.response.success === true || body.response.success === false)}}
valid.message: Unexpected task response. Preserve the task ID and inspect request history; do not regenerate.

temp.succeeded: {{body.finished_at && get(body, "response.success") === true && !get(body, "response.error") && length(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray)) > 0 && length(map(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray), "state", "state", "succeeded")) === length(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray))}}

output.status: {{if(temp.succeeded, "succeeded", if(body.finished_at && (get(body, "response.success") === false || get(body, "response.error") || contains(map(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray), "state"), "failed") || contains(map(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray), "state"), "error") || contains(map(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray), "state"), "cancelled") || contains(map(ifempty(get(body, "response.data"), emptyarray), "state"), "canceled")), "failed", "pending"))}}
